title: The kbmon mod awaits $.ui.notify inside its refresh, so a slow Notification hook freezes the pane, the receipt and the resize refresh
goal: the kbmon mod does not hold its refresh (the inFlight flag) while a $.ui.notify call is out, so the pane, the receipt and a resize refresh go on

clauses.clause: the kbmon mod does not hold its refresh (the inFlight flag) while a $.ui.notify call is out, so the pane, the receipt and a resize refresh go on

notes: Found by the review of SP-hja7yu5k (register.tsx:90). Live docs (code.claude.com/docs/en/plugins/mods/api, ui.notify): the user's Notification hooks run first and can take a while. The fix is a notify call outside the inFlight stretch (not awaited, its rejection caught). The repro stubs ui.notify to answer after an hour on the mock clock. Planned in SP-rin4kkoj (2026-10-24 night run, manager approval). Premise run on main b950692a97: the repro fails (the refresh count stays at 2 while the notify call is out). Same function as BG-jkdw723s, so it runs after it (depends_on) and builds on its code; the first bug lands first and its checks must still pass after this one (the call is still made, only not awaited, its rejection caught). Check: the repro plants a ui.notify that answers after an hour on the mock clock and asserts the pane goes on refreshing.
